record.paper_title: Open problems for the superKdV equations
record.context_brief: solutions for N=2 super integrable systems
record.original_question: Develop solution theory for N = 2 supersymmetric integrable systems, in particular Darboux transformations and related explicit solution-generating methods analogous to those already known in the N = 1 case.

evidence.quote: Moreover, little is known concerning the solutions of super integrable systems. The Darboux transformation in the N = 1 case has been worked out in [21] but nothing has been done at this point concerning the N = 2 cases.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Consider the family of N = 2 supersymmetric integrable hierarchies (in particular the N = 2 supersymmetric KdV equations corresponding to the parameter values a = -2, 4, 1), formulated on an N = 2 superspace with bosonic coordinates (x, t) and two odd coordinates (θ₁, θ₂), whose dependent variable is a bosonic N = 2 superfield Φ(x, t, θ₁, θ₂) satisfying an evolution equation of the schematic form Φ_t = -∂_x³ Φ + (super-nonlinear terms depending on the parameter a). For the corresponding N = 1 supersymmetric KdV system, Darboux transformations and associated solution-generating methods (Bäcklund transformations, Crum-type iterations, Wronskian/superdeterminant formulas) are known.

Develop an analogous solution theory for the N = 2 supersymmetric integrable systems. Specifically:

1. Construct an explicit Darboux transformation acting on the Lax operator (or zero-curvature representation) of the N = 2 supersymmetric KdV hierarchy, producing from a given solution Φ a new solution Φ̃ of the same hierarchy.
2. Derive the corresponding Bäcklund transformation and a nonlinear superposition principle relating multiple iterations.
3. Provide closed-form expressions (e.g. Wronskian / superdeterminant / Crum-type formulas) for the multi-soliton solutions and other explicit solution classes obtained by iteration of the Darboux transformation.
artifact.status_search_result: Subsequent work has constructed Darboux and Bäcklund transformations for specific N = 2 supersymmetric KdV equations (notably the a = -2 case), including nonlinear superposition formulas and induced discrete/lattice systems, and a Darboux transformation for an sl(2|1) super KdV hierarchy yielding a super lattice potential KdV equation. Thus the problem is partially solved for particular cases, while a fully uniform solution theory across all N = 2 super integrable systems is not established.

status_evidence.title: Bäcklund–Darboux transformations and discretizations of N=2 a=-2 supersymmetric KdV equation
status_evidence.snippet: Darboux and Bäcklund transformations for the N=2 a=-2 supersymmetric KdV are constructed; a nonlinear superposition formula is derived and used to build integrable discrete systems.
status_evidence.claim: Darboux/Bäcklund transformations have been worked out for the N=2 a=-2 supersymmetric KdV equation.

status_evidence.title: A Darboux transformation of the sl(2|1) super KdV hierarchy and a super lattice potential KdV equation
status_evidence.snippet: A Darboux transformation for an sl(2|1) super KdV hierarchy is constructed; its compatibility yields a super lattice potential KdV equation.
status_evidence.claim: Darboux transformations for super KdV hierarchies in the N=2 setting have been partially developed.
